versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "break-watch" skill for real-time A股 monitoring.
- Scans and outputs stocks meeting all three conditions: breakout volume, price increase, and bullish candlestick.
- Integration with pytdx to fetch real-time market data from Tongdaxin servers.
- Configurable scan parameters and multi-format output support (JSON, CSV, HTML, TXT).
- Outputs concise, structured signals for intraday strategy and risk monitoring.
